name: @skilllane/monitoring-demo-api
description: Demo NestJS app (school-core-api-like) that uses skilllane-monitoring, plus a traffic generator

scripts.start:core-api: DEMO_SERVICE=core APP_ROLE=api OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=school-core-api NODE_OPTIONS='--require skilllane-monitoring/register' node dist/src/main.js
scripts.start:core-worker: DEMO_SERVICE=core APP_ROLE=worker OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=school-core-api NODE_OPTIONS='--require skilllane-monitoring/register' node dist/src/main.js
scripts.start:etl-api: DEMO_SERVICE=etl APP_ROLE=api OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=school-etl-api NODE_OPTIONS='--require skilllane-monitoring/register' node dist/src/main.js
